name: djzs-pal-gate
description: A deterministic gate between a conversational agent and one money action. The model proposes, TypeScript decides, every decision is recorded.

scripts.test: tsx test/money.test.mjs && tsx test/ruleset-exhaustive.test.mjs && tsx test/say.test.mjs && tsx test/tavus-hmac.test.mjs && tsx test/gate-flow.test.mjs && tsx test/pal-register.test.mjs && tsx test/bundle.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --tag "$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)" --message "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
